title: Record Auction Prices for Gems
subtitle: Record auction sales of diamonds, rubies and pearls, with price per carat
description:
19 record auction sales of diamonds, rubies and a natural pearl, 2010 to 2023, from the records table in Chapter 14 of the Erebaur encyclopedia: price as announced and in US dollars, carat weight, computed price per carat, house, city and date. Prices include the buyer’s premium.

Data: Erebaur (https://erebaur.com), CC BY 4.0. https://erebaur.com/records/

The data dictionary, sources and known limitations are in README.md.

resources.description: 19 record auction sales of diamonds, rubies and a natural pearl, 2010 to 2023, from the records table in Chapter 14 of the Erebaur encyclopedia: price as announced and in US dollars, carat weight, computed price per carat, house, city and date. Prices include the buyer’s premium.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the stone or jewel, as sold or as later known.

fields.name: stone
fields.description: Description: color grade, cut, clarity, origin or setting, as catalogued.

fields.name: category
fields.description: pink-diamond, blue-diamond, colorless-diamond, ruby, pearl or other, read from the description. The same categories as the erebaur.com records page.

fields.name: carats
fields.description: Weight in carats at the time of sale.

fields.name: price_usd_millions
fields.description: Price in millions of US dollars as the chapter’s table gives it, including the buyer’s premium.

fields.name: price_usd
fields.description: Best available US$ total: the house’s exact US$ figure where it published one, otherwise price_usd_millions × 1,000,000.

fields.name: price_usd_basis
fields.description: exact_usd_total when price_usd is an exact figure published in US dollars; usd_millions_rounded when it comes from the rounded table figure.

fields.name: local_price
fields.description: Price as the house announced it, in the currency of the sale.

fields.name: local_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of local_price: USD, CHF or HKD.

fields.name: local_amount
fields.description: local_price as a number. Rounded when the announced figure is (for example "CHF 45.44 million").

fields.name: sale_date
fields.description: Year and month of the sale, YYYY-MM.

fields.name: usd_per_carat
fields.description: price_usd divided by carats, rounded to the dollar. Computed by Erebaur; can differ from a per-carat figure a house or GIA publishes.

fields.name: stated_record
fields.description: The record Chapter 14 says this sale holds, in its own words. Empty for every other row: a row is not called a record for ranking first in this table.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: What Erebaur’s editorial review records about this row. Empty when it records nothing.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Sources in Chapter 14’s list that name this sale: lot records, press releases and GIA reports, separated by " | ".

fields.name: erebaur_url
fields.description: The sale’s row on the erebaur.com records page, which lays the records out by category.
